name: flowershow
description: Publish what you made in an AI session as a live website: Markdown, HTML pages, notes and docs, with or without an account.

interface.longDescription:
Flowershow turns what you made with ChatGPT or Codex into a live website. Ask to "publish this", "put this online" or "share this as a website", and it publishes the page or small site and gives you a link to share.

Publish reports, one-pagers, dashboards and other HTML pages exactly as written, or Markdown notes and documents with a clean theme. Ask for changes in the same conversation and they go live at the same address.

No account is needed. Each new site gets a random address and a claim link: open the claim link and sign in to keep the site in your Flowershow account, where you can rename it or add a custom domain. Unclaimed sites expire after 7 days. Published sites are public. Each publish takes up to 50 files and 3 MB; in Codex, larger sites can be published with the Flowershow command line tool.
capabilities: Publish HTML and Markdown as a website
Update a site published in the same conversation
defaultPrompt: Put this report online so I can share it
Update the page you published with these changes

positive.prompt: Make a one-page HTML announcement for a bakery opening this Saturday at 9am, with a short menu, and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls publish once with an index.html file. Replies with a live https://…-anon.flowershow.me link that shows the page, and a claim link with a note that the site expires in 7 days unless claimed.

positive.description: Update the site in the same conversation
positive.prompt: Change the opening day to Sunday and republish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Run after the first case in the same conversation. Calls publish with the siteId and claimToken from the first publish and the complete updated files. The same URL now shows Sunday.

positive.prompt: Write three short Markdown pages about houseplant care (watering, light, soil) plus a home page that links to them, and publish them as a website.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls publish once with four .md files. The live link shows a themed site whose home page links to the three pages, and each link opens.

positive.description: Publish an HTML page with separate CSS and JavaScript
positive.prompt: Build a small dashboard page with a separate style.css and script.js that draws a bar chart of these sales: Jan 12, Feb 19, Mar 7. Put it online.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls publish once with index.html, style.css and script.js. The live page loads the stylesheet and script and shows the bar chart.

positive.description: Share pasted text as a website
positive.prompt: Share this as a website: Team offsite, 14 November. 10:00 welcome and coffee. 11:00 roadmap review. 13:00 lunch. 14:30 workshops. 17:00 drinks.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls publish once with a page containing the agenda. Replies with the live link and the claim link.

negative.description: No publishing requested: the plugin should not act
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: Deleting a site is not supported: no tool call; explain that an unclaimed site expires after 7 days, or can be deleted from the Flowershow dashboard after claiming it
negative.prompt: Delete the website you just published.

negative.description: Unrelated question: the plugin should not act
negative.prompt: What's a good way to keep basil alive on a windowsill?

review.commerce_description: Flowershow does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: publish HTML pages and Markdown from ChatGPT and Codex as a live website, update it in the same conversation, and claim it to keep it.
